author: reek
body: A row is a typed tuple of column values with a null bitmap. Each column value is either an integer, text, or boolean. The row format is: [null-bitmap-bytes...] [col-0-bytes...] [col-1-bytes...] ... Fixed-width columns (Integer = 8 bytes, Boolean = 1 byte) are stored inline. Text columns are length-prefixed (4-byte length + bytes).

author: reek
body: The by-name setter is the partner of row-get-by-name, and it was the half that did not exist. Callers wrote it themselves instead: TrackerDb carried a local row-set-value, and IssueStore called one that was never defined anywhere, which is a name a chapter cannot resolve and so a chapter that does not compile. An unknown column is a no-op here for the same reason it reads as ValNull there, so the pair agrees at both ends.
